context: Request: all New York-law credit facilities the firm ran out of its Banking & Finance practice as counsel on the facility itself, excluding warehouse/repo/securitization facilities and real-estate-secured mortgage or construction financings. Rubric: nine matters (1005-00001, 1006-00001, 1010-00001, 1012-00001, 1019-00002, 1021-00001, 1038-00002, 1042-00001, 1043-00001), each with its executed facility document, plus a precision criterion.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob plus a read of a guessed readme path.

stages.stage: Read documents picked from the file listing
stages.note: Two batches reading engagement letters, memos, filings and an agreement of the four matters at the top of the listing; two guessed paths fail; no keyword search at all.

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: Reads later sections of filings and memos of one listing matter.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes that no matter qualifies and discusses one listing matter as the closest.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Edits a matter-number cross-reference section.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Read documents picked from the file listing → Read a chosen matter's documents in depth → Write the response → Check or revise the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: Never searched; answered zero from the four matters at the top of the listing.

first_error.stage: Read documents picked from the file listing
first_error.why: It chose what to read from the four matters at the top of a capped listing without any keyword search, so none of the nine qualifying matters surfaced.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Recursive ls plus find, first 50 files.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords

stages.note: Reads the openings of five agreements and an opinion.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: find | grep for agreement-type file names, first 300 hits.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Two batches: openings of ten agreements, then engagement letters and agreement sections of seven candidates; several guessed paths fail.

stages.stage: List files in candidate matters
stages.note: Lists engagement, closing and agreement files of five candidates.

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: Reads engagement letters, opinions, closing memos and agreement sections of the matters on its short list.

stages.stage: List files in candidate matters

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: Reads agreement openings and later sections of four candidates.

stages.stage: Write the response

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Search file names for request keywords → List files in candidate matters → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Search file names for request keywords → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → List files in candidate matters → Read a chosen matter's documents in depth → List files in candidate matters → Read a chosen matter's documents in depth → Write the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: Path patterns anchored at the start of file names missed two matters, two surfaced matters were never opened, two read matters were excluded, and two non-qualifying matters were added.

first_error.stage: Search file names for request keywords
first_error.why: Its path patterns only matched file names that start with a facility word, so two matters whose executed agreements carry a prefix never surfaced, and it never searched document text.

other_errors.why: The per-matter counts just before listed two more qualifying matters, but the 23 matters it chose to list left them out and it never opened them.
It read two matters' executed agreements and excluded them as property- or construction-secured financings.
It counted two other matters as qualifying from their agreement openings and engagement letters.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob plus a shell find to depth two (empty).

stages.stage: Search file contents for request keywords
stages.note: Files-with-matches grep for request keywords alongside a folder glob that returns nothing.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: Two find | grep passes over file paths for agreement-type words, first 200 and 240 hits.

stages.note: Reads the openings of six agreements from six matters.

stages.stage: Finish the run

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Search file contents for request keywords → Search file names for request keywords → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Scan document text with an extraction script → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → List files in candidate matters → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Search within a candidate matter's files → Search file names for request keywords → List files in candidate matters → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Write the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: Two surfaced matters were never opened: one was excluded unread as property-secured, the other omitted.

first_error.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
first_error.why: Its grep and both file-name searches listed one matter's executed agreement, but of the six agreements it chose to open it left that matter out; it never opened it and later excluded it as property-secured without reading its documents.

other_errors.why: The execution-name search just before listed another matter's executed agreement, but it went on to list and read other candidates and never opened that matter.

divergence: All three failed. T0 never searched and answered zero from the top of the listing (partial listing as corpus). T1 searched file names with patterns anchored at the start of the name and missed two matters (search miss first); it also left two surfaced matters unopened, excluded two it had read, and added two. T2 surfaced all nine matters through greps and file-name searches but never opened two of them; one it excluded unread, the other it omitted (surfaced, never opened).
